freelance_worker.subject: Final payment still outstanding
freelance_worker.details: The job was signed off two weeks ago but the balance has not been released.

freelance_worker.subject: No edge protection on the slab
freelance_worker.details: Asked twice for barriers before operating near the open edge. Work continued regardless.
freelance_worker.resolution: Site supervisor installed barriers and the contractor was warned.

freelance_worker.subject: Site locked on the agreed start day
freelance_worker.details: Travelled to Nugegoda for an 07:00 start and nobody arrived to open the gate until 10:30.

freelance_worker.subject: Abusive language from the foreman
freelance_worker.details: Repeated shouting in front of the crew after a delay that was not ours.
freelance_worker.resolution: Not enough corroborating evidence to proceed.

freelance_worker.subject: Charged for pre-existing boom damage
freelance_worker.details: The dent was logged in the handover photos before the job started.
freelance_worker.resolution: Handover photos confirmed the damage predated the hire. Charge reversed.

freelance_worker.subject: Overtime hours not counted
freelance_worker.details: Four extra hours on the Friday were left off the payment summary.

freelance_worker.subject: Asked to work outside the platform
freelance_worker.details: Customer offered cash to continue the job off-platform after the booking ended.
freelance_worker.resolution: Customer warned and the account flagged.

freelance_worker.subject: Job cancelled on arrival
freelance_worker.details: Cancelled after I had already transported to site. No cancellation fee offered.
freelance_worker.resolution: Cancellation fell inside the free window.

freelance_worker.subject: Unstable ground for the excavator
freelance_worker.details: Ground was waterlogged and no matting was provided despite the forecast.

freelance_worker.subject: Unreasonable schedule pressure
freelance_worker.details: Pushed to skip the daily equipment check to save time.

freelance_worker.subject: Invoice disputed without reason
freelance_worker.details: The customer disputed the invoice but has not said which line they object to.
freelance_worker.resolution: Customer withdrew the dispute and paid in full.

freelance_worker.subject: No welfare facilities on site
freelance_worker.details: No drinking water or toilet access across a nine-hour shift.
freelance_worker.resolution: Site is a short-term works area and exempt under the current policy.

delivery_personnel.subject: Refused to sign the delivery note
delivery_personnel.details: The site refused to sign on handover, then reported the delivery as missing.

delivery_personnel.subject: Unsafe unloading area
delivery_personnel.details: No banksman and no exclusion zone while unloading a 25t crane section.
delivery_personnel.resolution: Site agreed to provide a banksman for all future heavy drops.

delivery_personnel.subject: Two hour wait at a closed gate
delivery_personnel.details: Arrived in the booked slot but the site was shut with nobody contactable.

delivery_personnel.subject: Waiting time not reimbursed
delivery_personnel.details: Three hours of waiting time was agreed on the phone but never paid.

delivery_personnel.subject: Blamed for damage caused on site
delivery_personnel.details: The loader was damaged by the site team after handover but charged back to me.
delivery_personnel.resolution: Timestamped handover photos cleared the driver.

delivery_personnel.subject: Address changed after dispatch
delivery_personnel.details: Drop-off moved 40km after I had already loaded and left the yard.
delivery_personnel.resolution: Change was inside the permitted notice period.

delivery_personnel.subject: Verbal abuse at the gate
delivery_personnel.details: Security shouted and refused entry despite a valid gate pass.
delivery_personnel.resolution: Site apologised and reissued standing passes.

delivery_personnel.subject: Fuel surcharge not honoured
delivery_personnel.details: The agreed long-distance fuel surcharge was left off two consecutive runs.

delivery_personnel.subject: No lighting for an evening drop
delivery_personnel.details: Asked for site lighting for a 19:00 unload and none was arranged.

delivery_personnel.subject: Asked to falsify the delivery time
delivery_personnel.details: Requested that I record an earlier arrival time than actual.
delivery_personnel.resolution: Customer warned; delivery record left unchanged.

delivery_personnel.subject: No turning space for the trailer
delivery_personnel.details: The access road cannot take a low-bed trailer and this was not flagged at booking.
delivery_personnel.resolution: Access details were listed in the booking notes.

delivery_personnel.subject: Missing straps after unload
delivery_personnel.details: Two ratchet straps were kept on site and never returned.

maintenance_tech.subject: Repair invoice unpaid for six weeks
maintenance_tech.details: Hydraulic repair was completed and signed off but the invoice is still outstanding.

maintenance_tech.subject: Blamed for a pre-existing fault
maintenance_tech.details: The gearbox fault was documented in my report before the service began.

maintenance_tech.subject: Machine not available at the slot
maintenance_tech.details: Travelled to Kandy for a booked inspection and the crane was out on hire.
maintenance_tech.resolution: Renting party covered the travel cost and rebooked.

maintenance_tech.subject: No isolation on a live generator
maintenance_tech.details: Asked to work on a 100kVA unit that had not been electrically isolated.
maintenance_tech.resolution: Renting party introduced a lock-off procedure.

maintenance_tech.subject: Parts cost not reimbursed
maintenance_tech.details: Bought seals out of pocket on the understanding they would be reimbursed.

maintenance_tech.subject: No service history provided
maintenance_tech.details: Repeated requests for the machine's service history went unanswered.

maintenance_tech.subject: Pressured to sign off an unsafe unit
maintenance_tech.details: Asked to certify a mixer that still had a hydraulic leak.
maintenance_tech.resolution: Unit withdrawn from hire until repaired.

maintenance_tech.subject: Yard closed on the booked day
maintenance_tech.details: Arrived for an 08:00 appointment and the yard did not open until 11:00.
maintenance_tech.resolution: Public holiday closure was notified in advance.

maintenance_tech.subject: Tools missing from the workshop
maintenance_tech.details: A torque wrench left overnight in the secure workshop went missing.

maintenance_tech.subject: Asked to backdate a service record
maintenance_tech.details: Requested that an inspection be recorded a month earlier than performed.
maintenance_tech.resolution: Record kept accurate; renting party warned.

maintenance_tech.subject: Callout fee reduced without notice
maintenance_tech.details: The agreed callout fee was halved on the remittance with no explanation.

maintenance_tech.subject: Working at height without a harness
maintenance_tech.details: No harness or anchor point provided for a tower crane cable inspection.
maintenance_tech.resolution: Harness and anchor points now supplied at every site.
